Context: 6. Extraordinary Leave

## 6. Extraordinary Leave  
Extraordinary leave is granted to a Government servant-  
- (a)
- when no other leave is admissible;
- (b) when other leave is admissible, but the Government servant applies in writing for extraordinary leave. - Rule 32 (1).  
Extraordinary leave cannot be availed concurrently during the notice period, when going on voluntary retirement. -GfD (2!, Rule 32.
